remarks: Welcome to this newly renovated 4-bedroom, 3-bath home on a quiet street in highly desirable South Wilton. The home offers a bright, open layout ideal for everyday living and entertaining, highlighted by a large family room with vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light. The newly updated kitchen features Quartz countertops, all new appliances, a large center island, and modern finishes, and opens seamlessly to the main living and dining areas. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a wall of built-in closets, a newly renovated bath with double vanities, and sliding doors to a Juliet balcony. Two additional bedrooms and a second full bath complete the second floor, while a second en-suite bedroom with new full bath offers excellent flexibility for guests, work-from-home space, or extended family. Floors have been resurfaced throughout, and the home offers excellent storage. The lower level features an oversized playroom or second family room with sliders to a screened-in porch with vaulted ceiling and access to the deck, perfect for outdoor entertaining. Additional highlights include a two-car attached garage, laundry room with brand-new washer and dryer, new central air conditioning, new heating boiler and water heater, whole-house propane generator, new garage door, and new septic system. Conveniently located close to Wilton and Westport town centers, award-winning schools, shopping, and commuter routes. Move-in ready and available for immediate occupancy.
